Option "Kande doguwa ce", is a sentence that describes a state ofbeing, but it does not contain a verb. "Kande" is a noun (a type of food), "doguwa" is an adjective (sweet), and "ce" is a copula (is), butthere is no verb in this sentence. The other options all contain verbs: "mutu" (die), "haihu" (give birth), "tafi" (go), and "karanta" (read).Therefore, the correct answer is Kande doguwa ce.
